programmes.d: When Ray runs into an ex-girlfriend, he tries to impress her by pretending that Henry, Charlotte and Jasper are his children.
When Captain Man loses his powers of invulnerability and becomes too afraid to fight crime, Kid Danger must keep Swellview safe.
When Piper's basketball coach quits, Henry becomes the coach of Piper's team; Henry is challenged by the League Board and its unorthodox rules.
After Schwoz creates a disease that accidentally affects Charlotte, Henry, his family, and even Ray, he quarantines them in Henry's house in order to find a cure.

Schwoz invents a vacuum to help Henry clean his house, but it accidentally sucks Charlotte inside; when Henry's family hears Charlotte and thinks the vacuum is haunted, Ray must distract them while Henry finds a way to get her out.
When Ray's memories accidentally get erased, Schwoz devises a plan to send Henry deep inside Ray's brain to get them back.
Lincoln and Clyde find out that "ARGGH!" is coming to town; Lori moves to the garage.

Luan tries out for the school play to get closer to her crush, Benny; when Clyde and schoolmate Zach begin bonding over a mutual interest in antiques, Lincoln quickly finds himself feeling like a third wheel.

Clyde is desperate to learn how to act normal around Lori, so he enlists Leni's help; worried that their parents are hurting their health from not being active, the children encourage them to exercise.

After discovering he has rituals, Lincoln worries he's predictable and vows to change things up; Lori develops the yips when she finds out that the golf coach from her dream college is coming to see her play.

Eager to be named Kings of the Con at the Ace Savvy convention, Lincoln and Clyde convince the sisters to go with them as the Full Deck; when the girls get more attention, the boys do whatever it takes to gain focus.

All of Lincoln's sisters develop a crush on his new tutor, making it impossible for Lincoln to study; the children complain about their house, but they start to feel differently after a tornado threatens to destroy it.
Lisa searches for the next big scientific breakthrough; Luna decides whether to play in a band with her friends or play with professionals.
The sisters think Lincoln is bad luck so they ban him from attending their activities; when Lincoln finds out his class is dissecting frogs, he and Lana embark on a mission to rescue them.

The Louds rent a boat for a relaxing day trip on the lake, but the family ends up marooned on a desert island; Lincoln and Clyde, as Ace and Jack, investigate when they discover a frozen food company is using Dad's recipes.

When a fancy grocery store opens on the block, Bobby rallies the family to do everything they can to compete; Ronnie Anne fakes being sick to watch a Lucha Libre match, which proves to be more difficult than anticipated.
When Lola advances to a regional pageant she worries she could lose for the first time; Dad has Mr. Grouse watch Lily while he goes to a concert, but things quickly start to go wrong.
When termites infest the house, half the family stays with Pop Pop and the others stay with Aunt Ruth; Lincoln has to complete a woodworking assignment, but has a history of failure on the topic.
SpongeBob house-sits for Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy; SpongeBob is a comedy sensation when he tells mean jokes.
SpongeBob and Patrick sneak into the Treedome; Gary follows Patrick around, and SpongeBob becomes jealous.
Rock, Paper and Scissors want to take the perfect photo for their Christmas card but run into a problem; Paper and Scissors get into trouble by pretending to be someone else.

Paper makes Scissors feel bad for not doing his New Year's resolution, so Scissors tries to do it in 12 hours; in order to feel smart, Paper puts together a book club with the least intelligent people he knows.
Wanda switches Timmy's brain with his mother's brain; Crocker decides to start hunting leprechauns instead of fairies.

Foop escapes from prison and convinces Cosmo and Wanda that he is reformed; when Timmy wishes that he is the teacher's pet, Poof grants his wish and turns him into a guinea pig in Mr. Crocker's class.
Timmy impresses his father's boss when he joins his father at work one day; Timmy becomes magically talented at soccer after accidentally eating Poof.
Cosmo's brother comes to visit; when no one wants to play with Poof, he runs away to Yugopotamia, a place where he is the center of attention.
Poof becomes unwell and accidentally turns everyone into chickens; Timmy steals Cupid's arrows in an attempt to make Trixie fall in love with him.
Everyone that Timmy cares about vanishes; Cosmo must receive a gland transplant.
Timmy tries to scare away houseguests; an unappreciated Timmy wishes that he were never born.
Wanda visits her successful twin sister, Blonda; Timmy helps Mark Chang celebrate the Yugopotamian holiday FLARG.
Timmy wishes that Cosmo and Wanda were Tootie's birthday fairies for one day; Timmy skips school and wishes that Adam West could be a kid again.
Timmy wishes that all the food in the world were desserts; Timmy finds that playing with dolls leads to serious trouble.
Timmy wishes he could do the opposite of what his parents tell him; Timmy wishes for the body of a teenager.
Timmy tries to help the star of a superhero television show; Timmy accidentally releases a genie from a magic lava lamp.
Cosmo and Wanda receive invitations to their high-school reunion; Timmy wishes he were the strongest guy on the beach.
Mark Chang seeks Timmy's help in hiding from his fiancé; Timmy must undergo a program that will teach him to make responsible wishes.
After Timmy is rejected from the school band, he wishes that everyone would love his music; Vicky is stricken by Timmy's generosity when he saves her from a horrible accident.
Crocker is convinced that Timmy's father is a fairy and sets out to prove it; Timmy meets his grandparents and wishes that they had never come to America.
The magic of Fairy World shuts down after Crocker is hypnotized into no longer believing in fairies; when Cosmo is ousted from the house, he becomes Dimmsdale's newest superhero.

Crocker wants an heir for his supposed fortune and fame; the Greek gods seek revenge when Timmy destroys Mount Olympus.
Poof watches too much of a classic but violent cat and mouse cartoon; Crocker is concerned about Timmy's grades; Poof will not take his medicine.
When Timmy's father is too busy to spend time with him, he wishes for more fathers; the Squirrelly Scouts and the Cream Puffs race to the top of Mount Doom.
Poof must stop his anti-fairy from destroying the Fairy World and his loved ones.
Timmy tries to thwart his parents' plans for his birthday party; Timmy discovers that his mother wants to spend time with him.
Timmy tries to help Catman find a safer job; Timmy's mother turns their house into a bed and breakfast.
Vicky gets fired from babysitting Timmy; Timmy wishes for a super girlfriend for the Crimson Chin.
SpongeBob and Patrick take Squidward jellyfishing; SpongeBob is a victim of Plankton's scheme.
SpongeBob goes to work at the Chum Bucket; SpongeBob creates SpongeDoodle, who plays pranks on everyone, forcing SpongeBob to erase him.
